name: Algolia Free Search
free_limit: 10K searches/month; 50K records; 5K recommendation requests and 5K crawls/month
watch_out: The standalone Free plan has fixed search/record/recommendation/crawl limits, no card requirement, and can be used for commercial production sites; Grow and Grow Plus are distinct metered plans that can bill for overages. Confirm the plan before enabling paid usage.
